svg.title: LLM Benchmark Evaluation — eight benchmarks, five models
svg.desc: Agnes model: agnes-2.5-pro-theta. Publisher-reported scores. Other series are Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B, Qwen3.8-27B, GLM-5.3-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. SciCode uses subproblem-level scoring. All axes start at zero. Missing results are shown as not reported.
